raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Why
Kimi K3.1 Pro (released 2026-10-23; weights and config.json announced for 2026-11-04) has no
Primus preset, and the K3 family has no MI455X recipe. Moonshot describes K3.1 Pro as "a
post-trained version of Kimi K3" (https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro), so the K3
architecture applies as is.

The existing proxy, `kimi_k3_8L_official` (8 layers at the released widths, EP 8 on MI355X),
does not fit one 4 x MI455X node: at EP 4 the expert-DP size is 1, so each GPU holds the full
optimizer state of its 224 experts per MoE layer, and the estimated static memory is ~621 GiB
per GPU at 8 layers against 432 GiB of HBM.

This PR is the baseline only: the preset, the proxy and a recipe that runs as committed with the
image's Primus-Turbo. No performance changes.

## What
Three new files, in the same layout as Kimi K3
(`kimi_k3` -> `kimi_k3_8L_official` -> `MI355X/kimi_k3-BF16-8L-official`). No existing file
changes.

- `primus/configs/models/megatron/kimi_k3.1_pro.yaml`: the K3.1 Pro preset. It extends
  `kimi_k3.yaml` without overrides until the K3.1 Pro config.json is public; then only the keys
  that differ from moonshotai/Kimi-K3 get overridden here, and the presets and recipes built on
  it stay as they are.
- `primus/configs/models/megatron/kimi_k3.1_pro_4L.yaml`: a 4-layer proxy at the released
  widths. Only the depth shrinks; the layer pattern is the first four layers of the release
  (KDA, KDA, KDA, NoPE MLA; layer 0 dense MLP, layers 1-3 MoE). Four layers is the depth that
  leaves room for activations (~277 GiB static per GPU; 5 layers ~363 GiB). `num_layers` and
  the two per-layer patterns live in the preset because both patterns are length-checked
  against `num_layers` and have to change together.
- `examples/megatron/configs/MI455X/kimi_k3.1_pro_4L-BF16-pretrain.yaml`: a one-node
  4 x MI455X BF16 recipe, from `MI355X/kimi_k3-BF16-8L-official.yaml`:
  - `model` -> `kimi_k3.1_pro_4L`, `expert_model_parallel_size` 8 -> 4, `recompute_num_layers`
    8 -> 4 (still full recompute over all layers), experiment / wandb names.
  - The batch is sized like the other one-node MI455X proxies instead of copying the MI355X
    4-node run: sequence 7168 -> 4096, global batch 128 -> 64, micro-batch 2, so each rank runs
    8 micro-batches per step. The MI355X batch gave each GPU 3.5x the tokens per step of this one.
  - Hyperparameters, the memory recipe (distributed + precision-aware optimizer, bf16 grads and
    moments) and the backends are the MI355X ones. fla's Triton kernels need Triton's expert
    scheduling off on gfx1250 (`TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0`); the recipe comment says so.

## Results (4 x MI455X, 1 node, 12 iterations, mock data, recipe as committed, image Primus-Turbo)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Model | 4-layer K3.1 Pro proxy, 93.84 B parameters (27.4 B per GPU) |
| Parallelism | TP 1, PP 1, EP 4, DP 4 (expert-DP 1) |
| Batch | seq 4096, micro-batch 2, global batch 64 (8 micro-batches per rank per step) |
| Precision / recompute | BF16, full recompute over all 4 layers |
| **Throughput** | **13,371 tokens/s/GPU** (median of 3 runs; 13,305-13,544) |
| Step time | 4.78-4.95 s |
| Model TFLOP/s per GPU | 458-470 at iteration 12 |
| Memory per GPU | 340.6-340.8 GB (78.8-78.9%) |
| Loss at iteration 12 | 4.687-4.688, no NaN or skipped iterations |

| run | node | tokens/s/GPU | s/iter (iterations 4-12) | memory |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | A | 13,370.6 | 4.88-4.92 | 340.6 GB |
| 2 | B | 13,305.4 | 4.90-4.95 | 340.8 GB |
| 3 | B | 13,544.3 | 4.77-4.88 | 340.6 GB |

- Throughput is the harmonic mean over iterations 4-12. Iterations 1-2 include JIT compilation
  (20.2 s and 13.0 s with a warm kernel cache; 80.6 s and 43.3 s on a cold one). Memory is the
  value logged at the last iteration.
- Noise: the three runs, on two nodes of the same type, span 1.8%.

## Reproduce
Image `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261019`; on that image Triton's
`is_expert_scheduling_enabled()` also had to be patched to return False for gfx1250.

```bash
./primus-cli direct --env PRIMUS_GPU_MODEL=MI455X --env NNODES=1 --env GPUS_PER_NODE=4 \
  --env TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0 -- \
  train pretrain --config examples/megatron/configs/MI455X/kimi_k3.1_pro_4L-BF16-pretrain.yaml \
  --train_iters 12
```

## Test
- [x] The three 12-iteration baseline runs above (no NaN, no MES / reset errors in dmesg).
- [x] `tests/unit_tests/configs/test_example_configs.py` for the new recipe; it resolves to 4 layers,
  896 experts, EP 4, seq 4096, micro-batch 2, global batch 64, recompute 4 layers.
- [x] pre-commit on the three files: `trailing-whitespace`, `end-of-file-fixer`, `check-yaml`,
  `check-added-large-files`, `check-merge-conflict`, `thirdparty-lock` (lock unchanged).
- [ ] Full unit-test suite (lint CI runs on this PR; GPU UTs need `ci:gpu`).

## Not in this PR
- MI455X optimizations (Turbo FlyDSL kernels for MLA attention, KDA, SiTU and attention
  residuals, no dataloader attention mask, less recompute, deduplicated alltoall, tuned
  hipBLASLt, ...): follow-up PRs on top of this baseline.
- The K3.1 Pro config.json diff: once it is published, a follow-up diffs it against
  moonshotai/Kimi-K3 and overrides only the keys that differ.
raw_graphql_pull_request.title: feat(kimi_k3): Kimi K3.1 Pro preset, 4-layer proxy and MI455X BF16 recipe

detail.title: feat(kimi_k3): Kimi K3.1 Pro preset, 4-layer proxy and MI455X BF16 recipe

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,145 @@
+work_group: ${PRIMUS_TEAM:amd}
+user_name: ${PRIMUS_USER:root}
+exp_name: ${PRIMUS_EXP_NAME:kimi_k3.1_pro_4L-mi455-pretrain}
+workspace: ${PRIMUS_WORKSPACE:./output}
+
+# Kimi K3.1 Pro official-width 4-layer (~94B) BF16 pretraining proxy for one node
+# of 4 x MI455X (gfx1250, 432 GiB each).
+#
+# Same recipe as MI355X/kimi_k3-BF16-8L-official.yaml, with the depth cut to 4
+# layers (1 dense + 3 MoE; KDA x 3 + NoPE MLA x 1) via the kimi_k3.1_pro_4L
+# preset, EP 8 -> 4, and the batch sized like the other one-node MI455X proxies
+# (sequence 7168 -> 4096, global batch 128 -> 64, 8 micro-batches per rank).
+# At world 4 / EP 4 the expert-DP size is 1, so the
+# memory recipe below (distributed + precision-aware optimizer, bf16
+# grads/moments, full recompute) is required, not optional. Synthetic data
+# (mock_data: true).
+
+modules:
+  pre_trainer:
+    framework: megatron
+    config: pre_trainer.yaml
+
+    # Official-width shape, depth compressed to 4 layers. num_layers and the
+    # attention / MoE interleave patterns come from the preset, NOT from CLI slicing.
+    model: ${PRIMUS_MODEL:kimi_k3.1_pro_4L}.yaml
+    overrides:
+      # ---------- log ----------
+      wandb_project: "Primus_Kimi_K3.1_Pro_4L_MI455X"
+      disable_wandb: true
+      stderr_sink_level: DEBUG
+      log_avg_skip_iterations: 2
+      log_avg_reset_interval: 50
+      log_interval: ${PRIMUS_LOG_INTERVAL:1}
+
+      # ---------- token budget ----------
+      train_iters: ${TRAIN_ITERS:50}
+      micro_batch_size: ${MBS:2}
+      # GBS must be divisible by MBS * data_parallel_size. With TP=1/PP=1,
+      # DP = world_size = 4 on one node; 64 = 2 * 4 * 8 (grad-accum 8), so each
+      # rank runs 8 micro-batches per step.
+      global_batch_size: ${GBS:64}
+      seq_length: ${PRIMUS_SEQ_LENGTH:4096}
+      max_position_embeddings: ${PRIMUS_MAX_POSITION_EMBEDDINGS:4096}
+
+      # ---------- hyper parameters ----------
+      lr: 1.0e-5
+      min_lr: 0.0
+      lr_warmup_iters: ${LR_WARMUP_ITERS:5}
+      lr_decay_iters: null
+      lr_decay_style: cosine
+      weight_decay: 0.1
+      adam_beta1: 0.9
+      adam_beta2: 0.95
+      eod_mask_loss: true
+      init_method_std: 0.02
+      layernorm_epsilon: 1.0e-5
+
+      # ---------- parallel ----------
+      tensor_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_TP:1}
+      pipeline_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_PP:1}
+      expert_model_parallel_size: ${PRIMUS_EP:4}
+
+      # ---------- 896-expert memory recipe (REQUIRED on one MI455X node) ----------
+      # At world 4 / EP 4 the expert-DP size is 1: each GPU holds the full
+      # optimizer state of its 224 experts per MoE layer. Distributed +
+      # precision-aware optimizer with bf16 grad/Adam moments halves the grad
+      # buffer and moments; fp32 master weights are kept. Estimated static
+      # memory ~277 GiB/GPU at 4 layers (vs ~416 GiB with fp32 grads/moments).
+      use_distributed_optimizer: true
+      overlap_grad_reduce: true
+      overlap_param_gather: true
+      gradient_accumulation_fusion: false
+      use_precision_aware_optimizer: true
+      main_grads_dtype: bf16
+      exp_avg_dtype: bf16
+      exp_avg_sq_dtype: bf16
+
+      # ---------- recompute: full over all 4 layers (block method) ----------
+      recompute_granularity: full
+      recompute_method: block
+      recompute_num_layers: 4
+
+      # ---------- data: MOCK (NullTokenizer, no external deps) ----------
+      mock_data: true
+      tokenizer_type: NullTokenizer
+      train_data_path: null
+      valid_data_path: null
+      test_data_path: null
+      split: null
+
+      # ---------- validation: off for a smoke ----------
+      eval_iters: 0
+      eval_interval: 100000
+
+      # ---------- Kimi K3 specific ----------
+      # fla chunk kernel + fla causal_conv1d, as on MI355X. fla is Triton; on
+      # gfx1250 Triton's expert scheduling must be off: run with
+      # TRITON_HIP_USE_EXPERT_SCHEDULING=0, on a Triton whose
+      # is_expert_scheduling_enabled() honours it. Fall back with
+      # PRIMUS_KDA_BACKEND=eager PRIMUS_ATTN_BACKEND=eager.
+      kda_backend: ${PRIMUS_KDA_BACKEND:fla}
+      # Unified KDA backend selector (supersedes kda_backend + K3P_KDA_CONV).
+      use_kimi_k3_attention_backend: ${PRIMUS_ATTN_BACKEND:fla}
+      moe_router_dtype: fp32
+      optimizer: adam
+
+      # ---------- ckpt ----------
+      finetune: false
+      auto_continue_train: false
+      load: null
+      save: null
+      save_interval: 20000
+      disable_last_saving: true
+      ckpt_format: torch
+
+      # ---------- Turbo / fusion: the MI355X measured-winner set ----------
+      # grouped GEMM + RMSNorm + permute fusion are memory-neutral and on.
+      enable_primus_turbo: ${PRIMUS_ENABLE_TURBO:true}
+      use_turbo_grouped_gemm: true
+      use_turbo_rms_norm: true
+      moe_permute_fusion: true
+      # Left OFF, each for a measured / asserted reason:
+      #   attention              -- the validated configuration is without it.
+      #   deepep                 -- breaks K3 numerics (first backward non-finite).
+      #   shared_expert_overlap  -- moe_layer.py asserts NOT-overlap on the live K3
+      #                             latent path; dies at forward.
+      #   sync-free              -- stage >= 2 force-enables DeepEP.
+      use_turbo_attention: false
+      use_turbo_deepep: false
+      moe_shared_expert_overlap: false
+      moe_use_fused_router_with_aux_score: false
+      turbo_sync_free_moe_stage: 0
+
+      # ---------- host-side overhead / MoE stability ----------
+      manual_gc: true
+      manual_gc_interval: 1
+
+      # FP8 off (bf16 sweep; prior FP8 hybrid showed no gain over bf16). Re-enable
+      # per-run via CLI `--fp8 hybrid`.
+      fp8: null
+      enable_experimental: true
+
+      # Cross entropy flags
+      cross_entropy_fusion_impl: "te"
+      cross_entropy_loss_fusion: true

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+#
+# Kimi K3.1 Pro text backbone.
+#
+# ~2.8 T total params, ~104 B active, vocab 163840 -- K3's shapes.
+# Source: https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro (2026-10-23): "Kimi K3.1 Pro
+# is a post-trained version of Kimi K3". The weights and config.json are
+# announced for 2026-11-04 and were not public when this preset was written,
+# so it extends kimi_k3.yaml without overrides.
+#
+# Once moonshotai publishes the K3.1 Pro config.json, diff its text_config
+# against moonshotai/Kimi-K3's and override only the keys that change here.
+###############################################################################
+
+extends:
+  - kimi_k3.yaml
+
+# tokenizer_model stays moonshotai/Kimi-K3 (inherited) until the K3.1 Pro
+# repository exists. Mock-data runs force NullTokenizer and never build it.

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+#
+# Kimi K3.1 Pro 4-layer proxy at the released widths, sized for one node of
+# 4 x MI455X (432 GiB each) at EP=4.
+#
+# Same rule as kimi_k3_8L_official.yaml: every per-tensor dimension is the
+# released one (hidden 7168, 96 heads, 896 routed + 2 shared experts, top-16,
+# latent 3584, MLA q_head 192, KDA 96 x 128); only the depth shrinks, and the
+# two per-layer patterns are the first-4 truncation of the production ones.
+#   layer 0: KDA + dense MLP (first_k_dense_replace = 1)
+#   layer 1: KDA + MoE
+#   layer 2: KDA + MoE
+#   layer 3: NoPE MLA + MoE
+#
+# Why 4 and not 8: at world 4 / EP 4 the expert-DP size is 1, so each GPU keeps
+# the full optimizer state of its 224 experts per MoE layer (~7.4 B params per
+# layer per GPU). Static memory per GPU (bf16 weights + bf16 grads + fp32 master
+# + bf16 moments, distributed + precision-aware optimizer, no activations):
+# 4 layers ~277 GiB, 5 ~363, 6 ~450, 8 ~621. 4 layers leaves room for
+# activations; 5 is the next thing to try if memory allows.
+#
+# Not exercised at this depth: attention residuals append a block checkpoint
+# only every 12 layers (attn_res_block_size), so the block residual never
+# grows; the release's irregular F F tail (layers 91, 92) is absent.
+###############################################################################
+
+extends:
+  - kimi_k3.1_pro.yaml
+
+# Literal 4 so it cannot desync from the two 4-entry patterns below (both are
+# length-checked against num_layers at config build).
+num_layers: 4
+
+linear_attention_freq: "([1]*3+[0])*1"
+moe_layer_freq: "([0]*1+[1]*3)"
